app_identity.name: Emergent CRM
app_identity.tagline: Real Estate Transaction Coordination & AI Operations Gateway
app_identity.theme_inspiration: Institutional Restrained Dark (inspired by www.thedoxs.com & www.losslessholdings.com with Knock CRM pipeline efficiency)

core_principles: Tactical Elegance: Deep obsidian panels, fine 1px charcoal grid borders, warm champagne accent highlights (#E5B869).
Storytelling Layout: Every screen feels like an executive command center for high-stakes real estate deals.
Density & Clarity: Knock-style card pipelines paired with side-by-side compliance review queues and real-time thread messaging.
Accessibility & Precision: High contrast ratios, strict data-testid tags on all interactive controls, no generic blue gradients.

layout.navigation: Left fixed sidebar (#0E1117) with smooth collapsible state, role indicators, quick stage switchers.
layout.top_header: Sticky glassmorphism bar (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0D12]/85 border-b border-[#232938]) with role selection (Owner, Team Member, Client), notifications counter, search input, and Hermes mobile connection status badge.

hero_properties.description: Modern luxury white villa with infinity pool
hero_properties.usage: Transaction detail banner & featured estate card

hero_properties.description: Modern house with illuminated glass facade at twilight

abstract_textures.usage: Auth page side background banner & Hermes AI hub hero

modules_breakdown.auth: Sophisticated dark institutional login with credential presets (Owner, Team Member, Client), password recovery modal, JWT session status.
modules_breakdown.dashboard_and_contacts: Knock CRM card-based pipeline (Lead -> Appointment -> Contract -> Closing) with stage filters, deal search, contact CRM cards, activity feed.
modules_breakdown.transaction_coordination: Detailed deal page with property specs, key milestone dates (Contingency, EMD, Inspection, Closing), auto-populated task checklist template with overdue badges, role-based document storage.
modules_breakdown.review_queue: Owner audit center showing side-by-side compliance, missing docs checker, interactive Approve / Reject with Revision Notes, full timeline audit trail.
modules_breakdown.messaging_threads: Unified conversation inbox with real-time thread filter, client ↔ team ↔ owner tags, @mentions, read receipts, and notification preferences.
modules_breakdown.ai_gateway_assistant: Proxy interface to Hermes LLM with template buttons ('Draft Client Email', 'Summarize Status', 'Closing Recap', 'Audit Checklist'), role daily message rate-limit counters, system prompt protection logs, and Hermes mobile phone agent approval bridge instructions.
modules_breakdown.hermes_traycer_integrations: Dedicated hub with copyable prompts for Hermes agent & Traycer Windows 11 desktop client, OpenAPI spec download/copy button, owner approval toggle.

testing_guidelines.requirement: ALL interactive components, inputs, buttons, tables, pipeline cards, and tabs MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use Javascript (.js) components for all React components.
Do not use universal CSS transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly specify properties (e.g. transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease).
Ensure dark theme background colors use solid obsidian tones (#0A0D12, #121620) with fine 1px charcoal borders (#232938) and gold accents (#E5B869). NEVER use raw un-tinted pure black gradients.
Use sonner for all application toasts (notifications, task completions, review submissions).
All interactive elements must have clear data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
